overviewHtml:
As environments grow, configuration changes target many entities, and you need their IDs to reference the right settings objects.

What you get

  • A DQL data source that fetches host groups by name
  • Results decoded into a local variable
  • A for_each pattern that creates log rules per host group
  • A simple starting point to adapt to your own cases
getStartedHtml:
You need an OAuth or platform token that can read the Grail data you query.

  1. Review the provider documentation for DQL permissions
  2. Adapt the DQL query and resource in the sample
  3. Run Terraform plan and apply
